name: dsh-shell
description: A native desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI.

scripts.icon: python scripts/make-icon.py && cargo tauri icon src-tauri/icons/dsh-shell.png

//: There is no dev server: the window is created in setup() with a URL that only exists at runtime, so `tauri dev` would only ever show the placeholder. cargo-run is the dev loop, and cargo-tauri does the bundling - Node is not required.
